caseName: Osage Oil & Transportation, Inc. v. Board of Adjustment of Fayetteville
caseNameFull: Osage Oil & Transportation, Inc. v. Board of Adjustment of Fayetteville

opinions.text: Appeal from Sup. Ct. Ark. dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari denied.
